_note: Placeholder calibration. Logistic weights and isotonic breakpoints zeroed (confidences resolve to 0.5); loose_min/tight_min zeroed so the server-side confidence gate is a no-op. sigma_meas_alpha=1.0 passes the PnP covariance through unscaled and sigma_meas_beta=1e-4 adds a small noise floor so the client Kalman filter doesn't collapse to zero covariance and lock onto its first measurement. Replace via `uv run fit-calibration` against a real capture corpus before relying on tight/loose tolerance gates. pipeline_version is the sentinel `placeholder` value (see core.calibration.PLACEHOLDER_PIPELINE_VERSION); load_global_calibration bypasses the pipeline-version check and emits a stderr warning when it sees this. A real calibration must pin to the localizer image's CONTEXT_SHA (LOCALIZER_SHA build arg).
